crossRefs.note: You have fed them with the bread of tears, and given them tears to drink in large measure.
For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mixed my drink with tears,
It may be that Yahweh will look on the wrong done to me, and that Yahweh will repay me good for the cursing of me…
As with a sword in my bones, my adversaries reproach me, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”
Many there are who say of my soul, “There is no help for him in God.”
“He trusts in Yahweh. Let him deliver him. Let him rescue him, since he delights in him.”
Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?” Let it be known among the nations, before our eyes, that vengeance…
Pay back to our neighbors seven times into their bosom their reproach with which they have reproached you, Lord.
Why should the nations say, “Where is their God, now?”

translations.web: My tears have been my food day and night, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”
translations.bsb: My tears have been my food both day and night, while men ask me all day long, “Where is your God?”
translations.kjv: My tears have been my meat day and night, while they continually say unto me, Where is thy God?
translations.asv: My tears have been my food day and night, While they continually say unto me, Where is thy God?
